items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the 2025 Einkommensteuerbescheid
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Document dated Wednesday 2026-11-18, sent by ordinary post. Bekanntgabe-Fiktion (§122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO) applies. Letter states the notice counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (18.11.+4 = 22.11., a Sunday); the statute actually in force provides the 3rd day (18.11.+3 = 21.11., a Saturday). Both candidate days fall on a weekend, and under the established rule that the fictional delivery date cannot itself fall on a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday it shifts to the next business day, which is Monday 2026-11-23 in either case — so the discrepancy between '3rd day' (statute) and '4th day' (as printed) does not change the result. Delivery (Bekanntgabe) is therefore deemed to occur on 2026-11-23. The one-month Einspruch period under §108 Abs. 1 AO in conjunction with §187 Abs. 1 and §188 Abs. 2 BGB starts the day after the triggering event (2026-11-23 is day 0, not counted) and ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 2026-12-23 (a Wednesday, not a public holiday in MV), so that is the last day the Einspruch may reach the Finanzamt.

items.title: Tax refund (Guthaben) to be transferred by the Finanzamt
items.quote: Das Guthaben von 715,00 € überweisen wir auf Ihr Konto DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18.
items.computation: The letter announces a refund of 715,00 € to the taxpayer's stated account but gives no specific transfer date or deadline, so no exact due date can be computed; it will typically follow shortly after the notice becomes final/unappealed, but this is not stated.

warnings: The Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states the notice is deemed delivered on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after posting, whereas §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO actually in force provides the 3rd day; in this case both readings happen to land on the same following Monday after the weekend-shift rule, but the discrepancy itself is worth double-checking with the Finanzamt if the posting date differs from the document date.

Double-check that the IBAN given for the refund (DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18) is indeed your own correct account, since a wrong or altered IBAN on a forwarded/scanned copy of such a letter is a common fraud vector.
